# Pre-registered analysis plan, stage 10: optimiser check with random search

**Fixed on:** 20 November 2026 (Asia/Kuala_Lumpur), before the first random-search trial is run. **Do not edit this file.** `bo_search.py --plan` stores its SHA-256 with every study and final run; later additions go in a dated addendum, deviations in `deviations_stage10.md`.

## Why this stage
Stage 9 optimised every model with one optimiser, a multivariate TPE sampler. This stage asks whether its results depend on that optimiser. It repeats the whole optimisation with plain random search, the standard reference optimiser, and compares the outcomes.

## What stage 9 found (the basis of the predictions)
- The best model on both datasets was asymmetric TGAE: five-seed validation F1 0.900 on UNSW and 0.947 on Deakin. The next best were 0.876 (TGAE, UNSW) and 0.912 (VRDAG, Deakin).
- In 13 of the 14 searches, the last 20 trials improved the best validation F1 by 0.006 or less. Seed-to-seed SD of the final runs was 0.001–0.019.
- Against the best simple method: learned clearly better on UNSW (EWMA, L = 4) and on Deakin (History-LR). On the 12 further UNSW days: learned clearly better than seasonal copy, and no clear winner against EWMA (L = 4).
- DynGEM and AERNN reached at most 0.742 validation F1 and still overfit at every size tried.

## Design
Identical to stage 9 (`preregistration_stage9_optimisation.md`) in every respect except the sampler:
- **Sampler.** Optuna `RandomSampler`, seed 20261120. This seed differs from stage 9's, so no proposal is shared with the random start-up trials of the TPE search.
- **Unchanged.**
  - The seven models and two datasets.
  - The search space.
  - Trial 0 is the published setting.
  - 40 trials per model and dataset.
  - The median pruner.
  - Up to 120 epochs, with patience 20.
  - The trial value: validation F1 at the validation threshold, seed 42.
  - Final runs: the best trial retrained with seeds 42–46.
  - Analyses A1–A4 of stage 9, run with `bo_analysis.py` on the random-search runs, with the stage-9 predictions O1–O5 evaluated again.

## Predictions
| ID | Prediction | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| R1 | On both datasets, the best model after random search is asymmetric TGAE. | Stage 9: it led by 0.024 (UNSW) and 0.035 (Deakin). |
| R2 | For every model and dataset, the five-seed validation F1 after random search is within 0.02 of that after TPE. | Stage 9: the searches had levelled off; seed SD up to 0.019. |
| R3 | The four classifications listed above (UNSW and Deakin test days; further UNSW days against seasonal copy and against EWMA) are the same as after TPE. | Stage 9 results. |
| R4 | DynGEM and AERNN stay below a five-seed validation F1 of 0.80 on both datasets. | Stage 9: 0.71–0.74, overfitting at all sizes tried. |

All predictions and analyses are reported whatever the outcome.

## Files
- `bo_search.py --sampler random`: search and final runs, written to `stage10_rs`.
- `score_newdays.py`: the further UNSW days.
- `capacity_check.py`: A2.
- `bo_analysis.py`: A1, A3, A4 and O1–O5, written to `stage10`.
- `rs_compare.py`: R1–R4 against stage 9, written to `stage10/comparison`.
- `run_stage10.bat` and `stage10_steps.bat`: run them in order.
